purpose: Synthetic identity table shared by all Aegis SDK fixtures.
notes: Generated from live contract invocations in the Soroban test host; values are rendered from wire-level ScVal/XDR, never hand-written.
All addresses are synthetic, derived from SHA-256("aegis-fixture/<label>"). They have no private keys and contain no real user data.
128-bit and 64-bit integers are encoded as decimal strings to stay lossless in JSON consumers that use IEEE-754 numbers.

scenarios.description: Fixed, synthetic addresses used by every fixture in this directory.
scenarios.derivation_detail: Ed25519 public key bytes = SHA-256 of the UTF-8 seed string; encoded as a Stellar strkey (G… for accounts, C… for the contract).
scenarios.privacy: No private keys exist for these addresses, they are unfunded on all networks, and they correspond to no real person or account.
